chunks: The Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said:
"Whoever renovates a grave or fashions an image has indeed exited Islam."

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: The title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام
key_terms.الْإِسْلَامِ: Islam, the religion of submission to Allah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about renovating graves and making figures?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام a severe condemnation regarding renovating graves and fashioning images. Its wording indicates a grave warning and underscores the seriousness of acts treated as incompatible with Islam in this context.
